page_title: OSA 3-3 VAL | Osasuna v Valencia 02/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' A dangerous towering header by Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
90+5' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
90+4' The free kick from long range, taken by Osasuna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

90+2' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Valencia are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' 3 - 3 What a goal! Sergi Canos swings a cross into the box and Umar Sadiq (Valencia) scores a magnificent back-heel goal! 3:3.
86' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Rafa Mir (Valencia).
83' Substitution. Jesus Areso did his best and is replaced by Ruben Pena (Osasuna).
83' That was close. Rafa Mir (Valencia) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
80' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Diego Lopez walks off the pitch to be replaced by Sergi Canos (Valencia).
80' Carlos Corberan prepares a substitution. Enzo Barrenechea is replaced by Pepelu (Valencia).
80' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
77' Mario Melero shows a yellow card to Lucas Torro (Osasuna) for his blatant foul.
73' Vicente Moreno has decided to substitute Bryan Zaragoza and he is replaced by Moi Gomez (Osasuna).
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Juan Cruz (Osasuna) will replace Abel Bretones.
72' The substitution is prepared. Iker Munoz (Osasuna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jon Moncayola.
69' A lofted cross from Luis Rioja (Valencia) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
68' Luis Rioja (Valencia) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mario Melero had an easy-decision to make.
67' Carlos Corberan decides to make a substitution. Jose Gaya will be replaced by Fran Perez (Valencia).
67' Today's match ends for Javi Guerra who will be replaced by Andre Almeida (Valencia).
65' Luis Rioja (Valencia) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
62' Luis Rioja (Valencia) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
62' A dangerous looking corner kick from Luis Rioja (Valencia) is cleared to safety by the defence. Valencia force their opponents to concede a corner.
61' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) hits a piledriver from long range, but the effort curls well wide of the right post.
59' Kike Barja (Osasuna) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.
56' Carlos Corberan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rafa Mir (Valencia) replacing Ivan Jaime.
55' A substitution has been made. Aimar Oroz is replaced by Kike Barja (Osasuna).
54' Luis Rioja (Valencia) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Sergio Herrera stops the ball out of the bottom right corner.
53' Diego Lopez (Valencia) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
52' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
52' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the right post. Terrific solo effort, though.
51' Ivan Jaime (Valencia) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Sergio Herrera easily deals with the threat.
49' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Umar Sadiq (Valencia) heads on.
46' The whistle blows and Mario Melero starts the second half.
45+7' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Jose Gaya (Valencia) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
45' 3 - 2 Goal! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Giorgi Mamardashvili into the bottom left corner.
45' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

44' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Joy for one side, despair for the other as the referee gives a penalty to Osasuna!
42' The corner from Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) is intercepted by the defence.
41' Osasuna work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
41' Jose Gaya (Valencia) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. Valencia are awarded a corner kick.
39' 2 - 2 Goal! Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes inside the left post. It's 2:2.

38' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Giorgi Mamardashvili sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom left corner.
37' A cross into the box picks out Diego Lopez (Valencia), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot well wide of the right post.
35' Dangerous play by Umar Sadiq (Valencia). Mario Melero blows his whistle for a foul.
32' 1 - 2 Goal! Javi Guerra plays a pass to the feet of Umar Sadiq (Valencia), and he shoots into the bottom right corner from inside the box. It's 1:2.

31' Valencia slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

26' 1 - 1 Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) is the first to get to a rebound and his weak, but precise effort finds its way through the defenders inside the goalmouth into the back of the net, bouncing in off the right post.

24' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score in the right side of the goal, but great anticipation by Giorgi Mamardashvili allowed him to make a comfortable save.
22' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) makes a slide tackle, but referee Mario Melero blows for a foul.
22' Ivan Jaime (Valencia) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
20' The ball is cleared after Ante Budimir (Osasuna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

14' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Mario Melero signals that the goal stands! The Valencia players celebrate. Diego Lopez (Valencia) gets one-on-one with the goalkeeper and takes an early shot which finds the back of the net.
14' Wait! Referee Mario Melero immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
14' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Diego Lopez (Valencia) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
11' A lofted ball into the centre of the box is met with a forceful header by Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna), but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
10' Ivan Jaime (Valencia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
7' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
4' Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
3' Osasuna are ruled offside.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Valencia will have the kick-off.
Mario Melero will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
